sql_method: Union of every migration SQL CREATE FUNCTION declaration and live clinic_app/public SECURITY DEFINER or policy-referenced pg_proc function.
Follow resolver SQL bodies transitively by qualified/unqualified function name, including every overload; SQL string bodies lack reliable pg_depend edges.
Pin live signatures, migration declaration paths, pg_policy dependencies and resolver callers, independently of runtime Python AST candidates.
Staff SQL guards have direct positive/negative oracles across all ten roles; non-staff protocols, cryptography, triggers and historical declarations are explicitly classified.
